sections.markdown:
## C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Right-of-way

FACT_ID: sec07-R01 | anchor: A01
A plain left turn yields to oncoming traffic, while a green-arrow left turn owns the right-of-way [A01].
Why it matters: group yield-rules; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec07-R02 | anchor: A01
Marked crosswalks, unmarked crossings, driveways, and parking areas all demand the same pedestrian yield [A01].
Why it matters: group yield-rules; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec07-F01 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec07-R03 | anchor: A01
Simultaneous arrivals at bare crossings defer to the right, while T junctions defer to the through road [A01].
Why it matters: group yield-rules; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec07-F04 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec07-R04 | anchor: A01
Red asks yielding to crossing pedestrians and through traffic, while green asks yielding to those still inside the intersection [A01].
Why it matters: group yield-rules; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F05 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec07-R05 | anchor: A01
Active sirens and lights demand pulling over, stopping, and waiting, while stopped flashers demand only a lane move or a safe slowdown [A01].
Why it matters: group emergency-response; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec07-F06, sec07-F07 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec07-R06 | anchor: A01
Walk starts crossings and don't-walk forbids them, while a countdown only lets started crossings finish [A01].
Why it matters: group ped-signals; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec07-F08 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec07-R07 | anchor: A02
Roundabout entry yields to every circulating lane, while circulating means counterclockwise travel, signed lane choice, and a right-turn exit [A02].
Why it matters: group roundabouts; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F09, sec07-F10 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec07-R08 | anchor: A02
Cars hold tight signed lanes in roundabouts, while trucks swing wider arcs that forbid driving beside them [A02].
Why it matters: group roundabouts; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec07-F10 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec07-R09 | anchor: A02
Open-road lane changes add mirrors, blind spots, and signals, while ramp entries add speed to match traffic [A02].
Why it matters: group lane-moves; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec07-F11 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec07-R10 | anchor: A02
A legal pass returns on the passed car's headlights in the mirror, while crossings, intersections, bus zones, and hidden views ban passing outright [A02].
Why it matters: group passing-rules; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec07-F12, sec07-F13 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec07-R11 | anchor: A02
Sight bans block passing at curves, hills, and near structures, while paint bans block it at double yellow, solid-side lines, and posted signs [A02].
Why it matters: group passing-rules; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F13, sec07-F14 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0019]
